definitions.explanation: A curved-blade cutting tool used for harvesting crops, cutting grass, and other agricultural work. A fundamental farming implement in traditional Japanese agriculture.

examples.english: To cut grass with a sickle.

examples.japanese: {稲|いね}を{鎌|かま}で{刈|か}り{取|と}る{作業|さぎょう}は{重労働|じゅうろうどう}だ。
examples.english: Harvesting rice with a sickle is heavy labor.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{物置|ものおき}には{古|ふる}い{鎌|かま}や{鍬|くわ}がまだ{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: In my grandfather's storage shed, old sickles and hoes still remain.

notes:
USAGE:
{鎌|かま} is a traditional farming tool still used in home gardens and small-scale agriculture. It also appears in many idiomatic expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎌|かま}で{刈|か}る (to cut/harvest with a sickle)
- {草刈|くさか}り{鎌|がま} (grass-cutting sickle)
- {鎌|かま}をかける (to try to trick someone into revealing something — an idiomatic expression)

RELATED WORDS:
{鎌倉|かまくら} (Kamakura) contains this character. Other farming tools include {鍬|くわ} (hoe) and {鋤|すき} (plow).

DO NOT CONFUSE:
{鎌|かま} (sickle) uses a different kanji from {窯|かま} (kiln) and {釜|かま} (cooking pot/kettle), though all three are read かま.
